name: Mesh Telco
summary: Melbourne B2B fibre/NBN/ADSL + VoIP provider (MeshTelco, ~2015) and its Life Wireless fixed-wireless 'fibre beaming' brand (Glen Waverley, ~2016); acquired by Pennytel Australia (May 2022) (MESH INTELLIGENCE PTY. LTD., ACN 606 840 322).

events.details: Business fibre, NBN, VoIP; ABR business name 'MeshTelco' from 8 Sep 2015. Ran the Life Wireless fixed-wireless brand from 2016.
Acquired by Sydney-based Pennytel Australia (announced 12 May 2022); the MeshTelco B2B and Life Wireless fixed-wireless bases folded in. Not the earlier 'c.2018' estimate.
